༄༅/ /rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi lhan thabs ma ṇi bum sgrub bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi lhan thabs ma ṇi bum sgrub bzhugs so//

chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i bka' 'bum gyi smin grol gyi las tshogs rnams bsdus pa phreng ba skor gsum gyi lhan thabs ma ṇi ril bu sgrub par 'dod na/ nas dkar/ 'bras dkar/ gro/ so ba/ sran dkar rnams gtsang zhing lhad med par byas pa rjen btags sam/ cung zad brngos pa zhib par btags pas gzhi blangs/ de la sman bzang po drug dang*/ ga pur/ sha pho ru rta/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ ar nag la sogs pa dri bzang po rnams dang*/ gnas yul bzang ba rnams kyi sa rdo shing la sogs pa yang bsres/ bram ze skye bdun pa'i sha dang rus pa gang rnyed dang*/ bla ma gong ma nang sel med pa rnams kyi dad rten dang gong ma rnams kyis bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu dang*/ chos sman la sogs pa'i phab rgyun ci 'dzom bsres pa la mngar gsum dang rgyun 'bab kyi chu/ mtsho chen po'i chu/ chu mig shar du lta ba'i chu/ ba ra mdzo 'bri dkar mo'i 'o ma rnams kyis sbrus pa'i ril bu che chung ji ltar 'tsham pa/ gas pa dang*/ ser ga /srub sogs med pa legs par dril la grib mar skam zhing rul sungs sogs ma shor bar bya/ bskams nas tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ ga pur dang*/ sa dkar po/ mtsho'i chu dang*/ sha ka ra'i khu bas sbyar ba'i na bza' dkar po gsol te/ de nyid rin po che'i bum pa gas chag med pa dang*/ ril bu so sor me chu rlung gsum gyis sbyangs/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs shing rta mgrin gyi sngags bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ ril bu bum pa ma gang tsam du blugs/ bum pa dar dkar po'i na bza' dang mgul chings ze prog lnga pa bya/ bum pa'i kha dar dkar pos btum la rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ bum pa'i logs rnams su rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan bris/ bum pa'i khar rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang cod pan dmar po btags la/ sgrub khog pad+ma rā ga'i phreng ba ltar 'tshogs nas dkyil 'khor bri ba yan grub par byas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khri khar bum pa bkod/

bum steng gzung thag lnga btags pa'i dbus ma slob dpon dngos/ gzhan ma bzhi po phyogs bzhi so sor drangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mchod bstod rgyan bkod la sogs pa sgrub khog kho na ltar byas/ de rjes bum pa la zhi ba/ phyed ma/ drag pos sbyang ba sogs rab gnas ltar byas la bgegs bskrad/ de rjes bdag mdun bskyed pa nas bsnyen pa'i bar sgrub khog kho na ltar byas rjes/ bum pa'i ril bu rnams ril bu re re thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa rgyan chas rdzogs pa re re bskyed la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ril bu'i lha rnams dgug gzhug bcing mnyes gnyis med du bstim/ slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs mchod cing gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas dbang bskur rigs bdag 'od dpag med re res rgyas gdab/ dbang lha rnams ril bu'i lha la bstim/ mchod cing bstod/ bzlas pa'i tshe bdag thugs rje chen por gsal/ mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams dang*/ bum nang gi ril bu lhar gsal ba rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hrīḥyig dkar po'i mthar yi ge drug pas bskor ba rnams las 'od zer dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad thugs rje chen po'i sku'i rnam par kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar spyan drangs/ bum nang gi lha rnams la sib sib thim pas bum nang gi lha rnams 'od du 'bar zhing yi ge drug pa'i sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar sgrog cing gar gyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa mdzad par bsam la gzung thag dbus ma slob dpon dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gzung thag yi ge drug dung phyur thon pa'i dge slong ngam rten gtsang ma re res drod ma yal bar bzung*/ gzhan yang sgrub grogs rnams dang bcas pas nyin mtshan thun drug gam/ bzhir bcad kyi ngang nas yi ge drug pa'i sgra skad cig kyang ma chad pa nyin mtshan bar med res su bsgrang*/

bum pa dang dkyil 'khor rnams yol bas bcad pa la gzhan gyis mi mthong bar bya/ thun drug tu gong gi dmigs pa dang ma bral bar smra ba bcad/ rol mo'i sgra dang gu gul gyi dud pa dang bcas te gdangs snyan pos byin 'beb pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ 'og min bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas// chos sku 'od dpag med pa gar gyi dbang*// 'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /ri bo po ta la yi gnas mchog nas// longs sku brtse ldan 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// 'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /ra sa 'phrul snang dag pa'i gzhal yas nas// sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po mchog /'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /zangs mdog dpal ri dpal gyi pho brang nas// sangs rgyas kun dngos slob dpon pad+ma 'byung*// 'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /gar bzhugs dag pa rab 'byams zhing mchog na// zab gter bdag po grub thob dngos grub nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma bud+dha rat+na'i bar// drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyang*// 'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /gnas dang yul chen dag pa'i pho brang nas// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro dngos grub bdag /'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog so so nas// ma dang mkha' 'gro phrin las sgrub pa'i bdag /'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig /dur khrod chos 'khor gnas dgon phyogs bcu nas// chos skyong srung ma bar gcod srung mdzad rnams// 'dir gshegs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin phob cig

|bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams// 'dir gshegs gnas mchog 'di la gzi byin bskyed// dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs// sgrub rdzas gnyan po 'di la byin cig phob// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rnams la rtogs pa bskyed// rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho gshegs pa'i tshe// g.yas na dpa' bo'i hūm̐ sgra di ri ri// g.yon na dpa' mo'i brda skad khro lo lo// mdun na dam can phaṭa sgra sangs se sang*/ rgyab tu bka' nyan bshug glu kyu ru ru// byin rlabs kun khyab sprin phung thibs se thib// dngos grub rnam gnyis sbrang char si li li| |nyams dang rtogs pa'i gdeng chen lams se lam// phrin las rnam bzhi'i rtsal chen sha ra ra// 'dir gshegs sgrub mchog mos pa'i bu rnams la// dbang bskur byin phob dngos grub myur du stsol// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra e ā ra li hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ.ā we sha ya a a āḥ zhes rol mo bsgrags shing byin dbab/ sgrub pa po rnams yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i gzungs chus khrus yang yang bya/ grib dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzem/ rnam 'joms dang sme brtsegs bzlas pa'i chus bum pa dang dkyil 'khor khrus gsol rtag par bya/ nangs re bzhin bsang mchod dang*/ nyin re gtor ma cha gsum re ma chag par btang*/ nang re bzhin slob dpon gyis sgrub khog gzhung bsrang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo yang yang mchod/ de ltar bsgrubs pas rtags rab thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ yi ge drug pa'i rang sgra thos pa dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams bzang po 'char/ 'bring dkyil 'khor dang bum pa la 'od dang du ba sgra snyan po dang*/ dri zhim po dang*/ ril bu mang du 'phel ba sogs 'byung*/ tha mar yang sgrub khang steng du 'ja' 'od dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ya mtshan pa'i rtags mang po dang*/

rmi lam du dar phyar/ dung 'bud/ ri dang mchod rten la 'dzegs pa sogs sgrub pa grub pa'i rtags spyi ltar 'byung*/ yang bgegs kyis bar du gcod pa sogs mtshan ltas ngan pa byung na slob dpon gyis rta mgrin gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal bya/ sngags drag po bzla zhing des sbyang*/ ma zhi na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sogs bgegs zhi ba'i cho ga gzhan ltar bya zhing ting nge 'dzin ngar bskyed la sgrub pa gal che/ kha cig ril bu sgrub khang gi phyi rol thams cad du 'phur ba sogs rtags mang po 'byung ba'i sgra skad 'dug kyang*/ de dag byed pa po rgyus yod rnams la lab lob skad cha mang du 'dug pa mi chos bla ma'i rdzun de 'dra ba ni 'dir tshad mar mi bzung ngo*// de ltar grub pa'i rtags mthong nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang pos dkyil 'khor la mchod/ dbang bskur byed na bum pa dang dbang rdzas sgrub cing bdag nyid 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba sogs dbang chog pad+ma rā ga'i phreng bar bshad pa dkyus ltar skabs 'dir bya/ de nas bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa ril bu rnams ngo bo thugs rje chen po la rnam pa dam rdzas kyi rnam par gyur par bsam/ bum pa zhal phye ril bu rnams longs spyod/ ril bu la la mer sreg /'ga' zhig chur bskyur| 'ga' zhig re rtser bskyal/ la la sa spyad bzang sar sbas/ la la phye mar byas te rlung la bskur/ 'byung ba bzhi la gnas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur grol ba'i smon lam gdab/ dkyil 'khor la gtang rag /bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu sgrub khog nas 'byung ba ltar las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar ma ṇi bum sgrub 'di nyid kyang rgyal po bka' 'bum du dngos su ma gsungs kyang mi rung ba ma yin par mthong nas sbyar ba yin la/ lag len ni bla ma gong ma phyag len rnam dag sgros thon par mdzad pa rnams kyi rgyun dang*/

thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor gter byon la lar bum sgrub mdzad pa rnams kyis bkab na rnam par dag par sems la/ bla ma la la dag gis bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i skye bdun sgrub pa'i lag len dang*/ sngags dang hrīḥha ra pañtsa sogs 'gebs pa mthong yang ma ṇi bum sgrub rang la tshul de lag len dag par ma mthong*/ yang la la dag gis dkyil 'khor cho ga dang 'brel ba med par thun rnams su/ mtshan ldan gangs ri pas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid 'don sgom sbrags pa'i rnyed dka'i rten mchog la sogs la gdangs ring zhing snyan par 'then pa sogs khyim pa blo brid pa'i chos brgyad tsam las lag len mi legs shing*/ yang la la dag gis bar do thos grol sogs dbang sgrub gzhan dang ma ṇi bum sgrub sbyor bar mthong ba ni/ sgrub gzhung de dang de'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor ci yang med pa la nan tan gyis sbyor ba rang bzo'i gya tshom 'ba' zhig tu mthong bas yid rton snying po med do// zhes pa'ang rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi bsdus don phreng ba skor gsum gyi lhan thabs su/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ shing khams lug gi zla ba'i dkar po'i bzang po gsum tshes dge bar rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba sid+dhi rastu// //sarba maṅga laṃ// skal bzang chos 'phel/
